svg.text: 30 deg; countersink them 90 deg on the bottom (LED) face so

svg.text: Lap the top face flat on fine paper on glass: the quartz window

svg.text: sits on it, metal to glass, and must bear evenly.

svg.text: Break the inside edge 0.3 mm. Passivate.

svg.text: Fit: it sits in the 72.4 recess in the cap's bottom face, flush

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with that face. Six M3 x 8 screws into the cap, tightened

svg.text: evenly in a cross pattern to about 0.5 N m.

svg.text: calculation; do not open it out.
